## BacaKomik is now Yoru

The app has a new name, Yoru, and a new app id on Android (`org.kurodev.yoru`). **Android installs Yoru as a new app next to BacaKomik.** It does not replace BacaKomik, and it starts with an empty library.

### Before you install, save your library
Do one of these in BacaKomik, in More → Backup & sync:

- **Drive sync:** sign in and sync. Then sign in to Drive sync in Yoru with the same account, and your library comes over.
- **Backup file:** tap "Back up data" and keep the file. Then tap "Restore data" in Yoru.

Both bring over your bookmarks, categories and reading history. These do not come over, so set them up again in Yoru:
- downloaded chapters
- extensions and extension repos you added
- settings

When your library shows in Yoru, you can uninstall BacaKomik.

### Desktop
- **Windows:** Yoru updates BacaKomik in place and keeps your library. The Start menu and desktop shortcuts are now called Yoru.
- **macOS and Linux:** on the first start, Yoru moves your library over from BacaKomik.

## Changes

### New
- The app is called Yoru. Shared links now use `yoru.kurodev.org`. Links shared before, on `bacakomik.kurodev.org`, still open the app.
